args.title: Fix handling of final empty line in parsed statement CSV files
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Adjust the parseStatement function to correctly handle trailing empty lines in CSV files without raising a 'Malformed row' error by verifying and skipping empty lines before processing. This change fixes the issue where files ending with an empty line fail parsing on the last row.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is caused by the parseStatement function raising an error when encountering a trailing empty line in the uploaded CSV statement file. This file handles CSV parsing and row shape validation. The fix will adjust the parser to correctly handle and skip trailing empty lines to avoid the 'Malformed row' error just past the last valid transaction row.
